hello.title: HELLO
hello.remember: Open hand near temple, wave out once or twice
steps: Raise an open hand near the side of your forehead / temple.
Palm faces the other person.
Move the hand a short wave outward (like a friendly hi).

thank_you.title: THANK YOU
thank_you.remember: Fingers on chin → move forward toward them
steps: Touch the fingertips of an open flat hand to your chin.
Palm faces you at first.
Move the hand forward and slightly down toward the person you’re thanking.

yes.title: YES
yes.remember: Fist nods like a head nodding
steps: Make a fist (like letter S / A).
Hold it in front of you.
Nod the fist up-and-down once or twice (like nodding “yes”).

no.title: NO
no.remember: Index + middle snap shut onto thumb
steps: Extend index and middle fingers with thumb.
Bring the two fingers down to touch the thumb (like a mouth closing).
Do it once or twice for a clear “no”.

water.title: WATER
steps: Make the letter W (index, middle, ring up).
Tap the index side of that hand lightly on your chin.
Repeat a small tap so it reads clearly.

need_help.title: NEED / HELP
need_help.remember: Fist on open palm — lift together
steps: Put a fist (or A-hand) on the open palm of your other hand.
Lift both hands upward a little together.
Face the person you’re asking so the motion is clear.

hospital.title: HOSPITAL
hospital.remember: Draw a cross on your upper arm
steps: With your dominant index finger, draw a small cross (+) on your upper opposite arm.
Keep the motion compact and clear.
This is the common ASL hospital / medical cross cue.

pain.title: PAIN
pain.remember: Index tips jab toward each other
steps: Point both index fingers toward each other in front of you.
Jab them slightly toward the same spot (as if pain is there).
You can aim the motion near the body part that hurts.

emergency.title: EMERGENCY
emergency.remember: Strong attention + clear HELP / emergency cue
steps: Wave to get attention if needed.
Sign HELP clearly (fist on palm, lift).
Point to yourself or the person who needs emergency help.

medical_help.title: MEDICAL HELP
steps: Sign HOSPITAL (cross on upper arm).
Then sign HELP (fist on open palm, lift).
Hold eye contact so the request is obvious.

sentences.hint: Practice both answer signs in a row.
Point to yourself, then NEED HELP motion, then WATER.
Point to the sore area while signing PAIN.
Spell letter by letter — hold each letter to advance.
Great practice when you don’t know the full WATER sign yet.
